prompt:
Our dev team uses three shared Codex identities — oliver, elise, and sylvia — to stay under quota limits. Right now the active session is stuck on oliver's account and we need to switch it over to elise immediately.

Once that's done, I have a quota snapshot from a measurement taken 4 days and 8 hours into our current weekly window — the numbers are in /workspace/quota_snapshot.json. Using those numbers, figure out which of the three accounts the quota auto-selector would have recommended, and explain the math. Save your findings (the score for each account and the recommended winner) to a file called quota_analysis.json somewhere in the /workspace directory.

The account management tool and all the related config files should already be set up under the home directory. Check ~/skills/ for the relevant scripts.
